steps: Discover step on (qa/bots/bot_run.gd _discover_step). Batch folder logs/qa-t209/batch2 (git-ignored).
Read the RESULT row: issues contains ['warning_streak', 40, "route 16 shows 'Waiting for room' for 3+ cycles in a row"].
Same warning in 80 of 304 runs across 41 arms (base seed 2, focus_mil, focus_min, dom_always_expand, most MIL/MIN ablations). Route 16 in 78 of the 80; routes 12 and 24 once each.
expected: A lane that the bot keeps running does not sit in 'Waiting for room' for 3 or more cycles in a row, or the storage it waits on has room.
actual: Route 16 shows 'Waiting for room' for 3+ consecutive cycles (up to cycle 40) in 80 runs. Cause not analysed (QA does not diagnose code).

steps: Read final_cash and cash_by_cycle: cash stays between 324 and 1218 across cycles 1 to 40 (480 at cycle 40) with 9 ships and 13 lanes built (lane_cycles total 172).
Same strategy, seed 3 (base decent 3): final_cash 26528, lanes 6, ships 6, cash 907 at cycle 20 and 25402 at cycle 40.
expected: Decent runs on different seeds end in a comparable economy range (or the spread is explained by the map).
actual: Decent base final cash ranges 485 (seed 1) to 26528 (seed 3), about 55 times. Seed 1 never grows cash. Economy-designer to judge whether this is a balance or map issue.

steps: Compare with focus_mil seed 1 (same seed, no skip): identical final_cash 9425 and identical skill_log (FND_PERMIT, FND_PROSPECT, FND_LEDGER, FND_STORAGE).
skip_skills is recorded as ['MIL_1'], so the flag is applied; MIL_1 is never learned in the market-focus arm.

Batch: 61 of 68 skill-ablation arms (all MIL, LUX and MIN nodes, most BIO nodes, plus FND_DOCKS) equal their comparator arm on all 4 seeds. The other 7 (BIO_1, BIO_2, FND_LEDGER, FND_PERMIT, FND_PROSPECT, FND_RIVAL_WATCH, FND_STORAGE) differ.
expected: Each ablated node is learned by the arm it is removed from, so removal can change cash, lanes or win.
actual: The decent bot in market focus learns only FND_* skills (2 to 4 per run), so 61 of 68 nodes have no signal. The tech ablations (--skip-tech) also rarely complete (MIL_2 3 runs, BIO_2 14 runs of 304). Skill policy is a bot or design decision: Producer to decide.

steps: Run the full batch (304 runs, 76 arms, 4 seeds, logs/qa-t209/batch2). Check win_cycle and ending_id in each RESULT row.
Every run: win_cycle -1, ending_id END_UNFINISHED, outcome soft, cycle_reached 40 (including market-focus arms and strategy arms).
expected: A decent player with market focus reaches the Bazaar win in the cycle window the design sets (about 22 to 30 per the pacing check), or the bot records why it cannot.
actual: No run records a win. The bot cannot detect the Bazaar win (stub, T281: share, best market and win-streak fields are 0 or empty), so win timing and pacing cannot be judged. Treat as unverified until the detector is wired. Not a new defect; re-raised because it blocks the pacing verdict.
